field_evidence.proposal: Remodelling of existing hot food takeaway, restaurant and first floor accommodation to provide hot food takeaway restaurant with new extraction flue to rear and one 2-bed apartment on the first floor. Demolition works and erection of two detached two-storey apartment buildings to rear, each comprising two 1-bed units with external staircases to first floor and parking.
